caption: The drawing features a single, rounded vase depicted twice on a plain beige background. The upper portion of the image shows a colored illustration of the vase, which has a wide mouth, slightly flared rim, and a rounded body that tapers toward a small base. The vase’s surface is adorned with vertical stripes in alternating shades of dark brown or black and purple-red, with a sandy brown rim and base. Highlights and shadows are present, suggesting a reflective, glazed surface. Below the colored illustration, there is a technical, uncolored line drawing of the vase, showing the outline and proportions with precise measurements and scale indicated by numbers at the bottom. The artist’s signature, "Albert Eyth," appears in the lower left corner. The overall composition places the colored vase above the technical diagram, with both centered on the page.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
